name: artisans-corner
description: Artisan's Corner - a multi-vendor marketplace for handmade goods

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev:memory" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run audit:ci && npm run test:e2e
